newsitem.title: USA: Gateway 2000 sees Q2 revs flat with Q1.
newsitem.headline: Gateway 2000 sees Q2 revs flat with Q1.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc, a direct marketer of personal computers, expects revenues for the second quarter to be about flat with the first quarter, the company said Tuesday.
The company reported revenues of $1.42 billion in the first quarter.

The revenues are not expected to reach analysts' expectations for the quarter, chairman Ted Waitt said in a news release summarizing comments he made before an investors conference in New York Tuesday.

"We continue to be very positive on the outlook for the second half of the year," Waitt said. "Even though the second quarter is weaker than what we would have anticipated, we continue to feel very good about our competitive position heading into the last half of the year, the period that historically accounts for the biggest percentage of our business."
Waitt said demand was starting to accelerate, but a seasonal spike came later than expected.

Gross margins for the quarter are expected to be in line with expectations, Waitt said, although company officials were not available to say what those expectations were. Unit growth year-on-year should still be in excess of 30 percent for the quarter.

Operating expenses for the quarter were running higher than analysts' expectations, mainly as a result of investments to provide support for the anticipated strong sales in the second half of the year, Waitt said. As a result of this increased spending and lower than expected sales in the quarter, operating expenses as a percentage of revenues for the quarter should increase by about one percentage point from the 12 percent rate experienced in the second quarter last year and the first quarter of this year.
Gateway 2000 shares were up 1-1/4 at 34-3/4 Tuesday.
